items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-06-06
items.q: A very, very fine play directed here by Mrs. Myra Hemings. I had the leading role in that also.

ctx.x: Are there any particular questions that you would like to ask me concerning any of the music career or pictures I'd be happy to show them to you? This one here Paul, I'm also somewhat of an actor on the stage. I played in about five or six major productions, that is locally. Was offered a part in Deep of the Roots on Broadway but didn't accept it. This picture here is Dark Tower. A very, very fine play directed here by Mrs. Myra Hemings. I had the leading role in that also.
And when did you start acting?
